create_BinaryReaderThreaded: create a BinaryReaderThreaded instance to read media files from a data folder using multiple worker threads
run_BinaryReaderThreaded: run the BinaryReaderThreaded pipeline step to process a documents pipeline with threaded media reading
read_media_record: read a single media record from a Media object and return its bytes using a thread-local file pointer
build_media_reader: build a subclass of BinaryReaderThreaded that implements read_media_record to read binary media data
test_BinaryReaderThreaded: test the BinaryReaderThreaded class with preserve_order enabled to verify output ordering
